# Allternit_CODEBASE_ATLAS

## 1. Repository Identity
- Repo name: allternit (repository metadata). (Cargo.toml)
- Repo structure: monorepo with Rust workspace members and pnpm workspace packages. (Cargo.toml, pnpm-workspace.yaml)
- Primary languages: Rust for core services and crates, TypeScript/JavaScript for UI and Node services, Python for ML/voice services, plus shell scripts for orchestration. (Cargo.toml, services/kernel/src/main.rs, apps/shell/package.json, services/browser-runtime/src/index.ts, services/voice-service/api/main.py, dev/run.sh)
- Frameworks: Axum (Rust HTTP) in kernel and services, React + Vite in the shell UI, Electron for desktop shell, Express for browser runtime/gateways, FastAPI for voice and UI-TARS operator, Playwright for browser automation. (services/kernel/src/main.rs, apps/shell/package.json, apps/shell-electron/package.json, services/browser-runtime/src/index.ts, services/voice-service/api/main.py, services/ui-tars-operator/src/main.py, services/browser-runtime/src/browser.ts)
- Package managers: Cargo for Rust, pnpm workspace for JS packages, npm in app/service scripts, pip for Python services. (Cargo.toml, pnpm-workspace.yaml, pnpm-lock.yaml, package-lock.json, apps/shell/package.json, services/voice-service/api/requirements.txt)
- Build tools: cargo build/test, Makefile targets, TypeScript compiler, Vite bundling, Electron build scripts. (Makefile, apps/ui/package.json, apps/shell/package.json, apps/shell-electron/package.json)
- CI/CD: GitHub Actions workflows for lint/test/build/release validation and evals. (.github/workflows/ci-cd.yml, .github/workflows/eval.yml)
- OS targets: CI builds linux and darwin; GUI tooling relies on macOS utilities (screencapture/cliclick/osascript). (.github/workflows/ci-cd.yml, services/kernel/src/gui_tools.rs)
- Runtime targets: Rust services (kernel, webvm, memory, framework), Node services (browser runtime, a2a/agui gateways), Python services (voice, UI-TARS operator, superconductor), Electron desktop shell, browser-based shell UI. (services/kernel/src/main.rs, services/webvm-service/src/main.rs, services/memory/src/main.rs, services/framework/src/main.rs, services/browser-runtime/src/index.ts, services/a2a-gateway/src/index.ts, services/agui-gateway/src/index.ts, services/voice-service/api/main.py, services/ui-tars-operator/src/main.py, services/superconductor/src/main.py, apps/shell-electron/main/index.cjs, apps/shell/src/main.tsx)
- GPU/CPU assumptions: voice service selects CUDA if available for XTTS; local inference references an MLX model path and local python process. (services/voice-service/api/main.py, services/local-inference/src/main.rs)
- Local dev environment: scripts start voice/webvm/kernel/shell UI, create venvs, and write logs. (dev/run.sh, scripts/start-all.sh, Makefile)
- Entry points: kernel server, voice API, webvm service, browser runtime, shell UI, CLI, Electron shell, API service. (services/kernel/src/main.rs, services/voice-service/api/main.py, services/webvm-service/src/main.rs, services/browser-runtime/src/index.ts, apps/shell/src/main.tsx, apps/cli/src/main.rs, apps/shell-electron/main/index.cjs, apps/api/src/main.rs)

## 2. Directory Map
### Repo Root: Top-Level Directories and Purpose
- `.beads/`: Beads issue tracking artifacts and config. (.beads/README.md, .beads/config.yaml, .beads/issues.jsonl)
- `.git/`: git repository metadata. (.git/HEAD)
- `.github/`: CI/CD workflows and automation. (.github/workflows/ci-cd.yml, .github/workflows/eval.yml)
- `.codex/`: local Codex skill bundles and datasets. (.codex/skills/ui-ux-pro-max/SKILL.md)
- `.gizzi/`: gizzi skill bundle mirror. (.gizzi/skills/ui-ux-pro-max/SKILL.md)
- `.gemini/`: gemini skill bundle mirror. (.gemini/skills/ui-ux-pro-max/SKILL.md)
- `.shared/`: shared skill datasets used by the bundled UI/UX skill. (.shared/ui-ux-pro-max/data/ui-reasoning.csv)
- `.logs/`: log output directory referenced by startup scripts. (scripts/start-all.sh)
- `.venv/`: python virtual environment directory pattern used by scripts (service-local venvs). (dev/run.sh, apps/cli/src/commands/daemon.rs)
- `apps/`: application frontends and CLI. (apps/cli/src/main.rs, apps/shell/src/main.tsx, apps/shell-electron/main/index.cjs, apps/ui/src/a2ui/renderer.ts)
- `bin/`: helper scripts and orchestrators. (bin/dev-up, bin/dev-down, bin/platform_orchestrator.rs, bin/comfy-capsule)
- `crates/`: Rust library crates (kernel, skills, tools, etc.). (crates/kernel/messaging/src/lib.rs, crates/skills/src/lib.rs, crates/kernel/tools-gateway/src/lib.rs)
- `dev/`: dev startup script. (dev/run.sh)
- `dist/`: packaged outputs and bundled assets. (dist/allternit.sh)
- `docs/`: documentation corpus and audits. (docs/README.md, docs/DOCUMENTATION_INDEX.md)
- `examples/`: example code and wasm tool example. (examples/wasm-tool-echo/README.md)
- `infra/`: infrastructure configs (nginx, docker). (infra/gateway/nginx.conf, infra/docker-compose/development.yml)
- `intent/`: intent and context docs. (intent/00_Context.md)
- `launchd/`: macOS LaunchAgent templates. (launchd/com.allternit.kernel.plist.template)
- `node_modules/`: JS dependency install output for Node projects. (package-lock.json, apps/shell/package.json)
- `packages/`: JS/TS packages (SDKs and executors). (packages/capsule-sdk/src/index.ts, packages/executor-core/src/executor.interface.ts, packages/executor-superconductor/src/superconductor.executor.ts)
- `plan/`: roadmap and backlog planning docs. (plan/30_Roadmap.md, plan/40_Backlog.md)
- `reference/`: third-party or reference codebases and MLX examples. (reference/mlx-examples/README.md, reference/extism/README.md)
- `scripts/`: shell/python automation scripts. (scripts/start-all.sh, scripts/python/update_rlm_issue.py)
- `services/`: runtime services (kernel, voice, webvm, gateways). (services/kernel/src/main.rs, services/voice-service/api/main.py, services/webvm-service/src/main.rs)
- `spec/`: architecture specifications and law documents. (spec/UNIFIED_UI_IMPLEMENTATION.md, spec/Allternit_Kernel_FullSpec.md)
- `target/`: Rust build output (cargo default build dir). (Makefile)
- `tests/`: integration, load, and acceptance tests. (tests/api.rs, tests/e2e_execution_pipeline.rs, tests/acceptance/phase0_acceptance_tests.md)
- `types/`: generated or exported TS types. (types/a2ui-types.ts, types/capsule-spec.ts)
- `workspace/`: runtime data, history ledger, and vault. (workspace/agents.json, workspace/history.jsonl, workspace/vault/graph.json)

## 3. Boot Sequence
### dev/run.sh (local dev)
- Builds `allternit` then starts voice service (uvicorn), webvm, shell UI, and kernel. (dev/run.sh)
- Voice service environment: `AUDIO_OUTPUT_DIR` and `PORT=8001` set before uvicorn. (dev/run.sh)
- WebVM base URL is set via `WEBVM_BASE_URL` to `http://localhost:8002`. (dev/run.sh)
- Kernel binds to `PORT` env var, defaulting to 3004 if unset. (services/kernel/src/main.rs)

Code evidence (selected lines, ASCII-only):
```bash
export AUDIO_OUTPUT_DIR="$Allternit_ROOT/tmp/voice-service"
export PORT=8001
export WEBVM_BASE_URL="http://localhost:8002"
nohup cargo run --release --bin kernel > logs/kernel.log 2>&1 &
```
(dev/run.sh)

```rust
let port = std::env::var("PORT").unwrap_or_else(|_| "3004".to_string());
let addr = format!("127.0.0.1:{}", port);
let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind(&addr).await?;
```
(services/kernel/src/main.rs)

### scripts/start-all.sh (voice + shell UI)
- Kills ports 8001/5173/4173/3000, then starts voice and shell UI only. (scripts/start-all.sh)
```bash
lsof -ti:8001 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true
lsof -ti:5173 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true
lsof -ti:3000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true
```
(scripts/start-all.sh)

### bin/dev-up (launchd + nginx)
- Generates nginx config and loads launchd plists for gateway, kernels, shell, UI-TARS, AGUI. (bin/dev-up, launchd/*.plist.template, infra/gateway/nginx.conf)
- Builds kernel release before launchd load. (bin/dev-up)

### apps/cli daemon (CLI-managed services)
- CLI defines a definitive port list and launches Rust/Python services with `PORT` env var. (apps/cli/src/commands/daemon.rs)
```text

- 5173  - shell-ui (Vite)

- 8010  - agui-gateway (TypeScript/Node)
- 8011  - copilot-runtime (TypeScript/Node)
- 8012  - a2a-gateway (TypeScript/Node)
```
(apps/cli/src/commands/daemon.rs)

### IPC channels and event streams
- Kernel exposes WebSocket endpoints for terminal and orchestrator, plus SSE streams for brain session events and integration events. (services/kernel/src/main.rs)
- Shell UI connects via EventSource to `/v1/sessions/:id/events` for brain streams. (apps/shell/src/runtime/BrainContext.tsx)
- AGUI gateway exposes WebSocket broadcast for UI events. (services/agui-gateway/src/index.ts)
- Browser runtime uses WebSocket for session events and provides HTTP endpoints. (services/browser-runtime/src/index.ts)
- IO daemon defines JSON-RPC messages and IO bridge readiness endpoints. (services/io-daemon/src/main.rs)

## 4. Agent Architecture
### Agent definitions and registries
- `AgentSpec` (role, tools, policies, publisher/signature) defines kernel-level agent templates. (services/kernel/src/types.rs)
- `AgentRegistry` persists templates to `agents.json` and seeds default `researcher` and `builder`. (services/kernel/src/agent_registry.rs)
- `AgentDefinition` and `AgentRouter` live in orchestration crate for routing by capability/keywords. (crates/orchestration/agents/src/lib.rs)

```rust
pub struct AgentSpec {
    pub id: String,
    pub role: String,
    pub description: String,
    pub tools: Vec<String>,
    pub policies: Vec<String>,
    pub publisher: AgentPublisher,
    pub signature: AgentSignature,
}
```
(services/kernel/src/types.rs)

### Brain session types and lifecycle
- Brain session types are `Api`, `Cli`, and `Local`. (services/kernel/src/brain/types.rs)
- Session lifecycle status includes Created/Starting/Ready/Running/Paused/Exited/Terminated/Error. (services/kernel/src/brain/types.rs)
- Brain events include session lifecycle, chat deltas, terminal deltas, tool calls/results, artifact events, and integration steps. (services/kernel/src/brain/types.rs)

### Spawn mechanics and execution sandbox
- BrainManager resolves drivers, creates runtimes, sets workspace directory, spawns PTY for CLI brains, and persists session metadata. (services/kernel/src/brain/manager.rs)
- CLI driver verifies command existence, applies optional sandbox settings (workspace_only, network_enabled), and runs in a PTY via TerminalManager. (services/kernel/src/brain/drivers/cli.rs, services/kernel/src/terminal_manager.rs)
- API driver streams to Gemini or Anthropic based on config id and env var API keys. (services/kernel/src/brain/drivers/api.rs)
- Local driver posts to local Ollama endpoint (default http://localhost:11434). (services/kernel/src/brain/drivers/local.rs)

```rust
if let Some(sandbox) = &config.sandbox {
    if sandbox.workspace_only {
        env.retain(|k, _| !k.contains("KEY") && !k.contains("SECRET") && !k.contains("TOKEN"));
    }
    if !sandbox.network_enabled {
        // This would need OS-level support (unshare -n)
    }
}
```
(services/kernel/src/brain/drivers/cli.rs)

```rust
let shell = if cfg!(target_os = "windows") { "powershell.exe" } else { "zsh" };
self.create_custom_session(shell, &[], None, None).await
```
(services/kernel/src/terminal_manager.rs)

### Memory binding and persistence
- BrainStore persists sessions to sqlite (`brain_sessions` table) with conversation_state. (services/kernel/src/brain/store.rs)
- BrainManager syncs session state periodically and stores conversation_state. (services/kernel/src/brain/manager.rs)

### Skill attachment, tool registry, and task graph
- Kernel initializes `SkillRegistry`, `ToolGateway`, `WorkflowEngine`, `MessagingSystem`, and `MemoryFabric`. (services/kernel/src/main.rs)
- Workflow engine uses task queue, policy, and tool gateway to execute node graphs. (crates/orchestration/workflows/src/lib.rs)
- Messaging system provides TaskQueue/EventBus envelopes including Agent Mail and leases. (crates/kernel/messaging/src/lib.rs)

### MCP integration and tool registry
- ToolGateway defines tool execution request/response with policy gating, resource limits, and network/filesystem access. (crates/kernel/tools-gateway/src/lib.rs)
- Kernel exposes tool routes `/v1/tools` and `/v1/tools/:id/execute`. (services/kernel/src/main.rs)

### Failure handling and logging
- BrainManager marks sessions exited on dead PIDs and emits error events. (services/kernel/src/brain/manager.rs, services/kernel/src/brain/types.rs)
- Kernel uses tracing subscriber and logs for major subsystems. (services/kernel/src/main.rs)

## 5. Runtime Systems
- CLI runtime: `apps/cli` provides commands for daemon, tools, skills, RLM, voice, WebVM, marketplace, and brain sessions. (apps/cli/src/main.rs)
- PTY runtime: TerminalManager spawns shells/commands via portable_pty and streams output. (services/kernel/src/terminal_manager.rs)
- Browser runtime: Node service using Express + WebSocket with Playwright automation. (services/browser-runtime/src/index.ts, services/browser-runtime/src/browser.ts)
- WebVM runtime: Rust Axum service managing sessions and static assets. (services/webvm-service/src/main.rs)
- Voice runtime: FastAPI service wrapping Chatterbox/XTTS/Piper for TTS/voice cloning. (services/voice-service/api/main.py)
- UI-TARS runtime: FastAPI service using OpenAI-compatible API with fallback mock parsing. (services/ui-tars-operator/src/main.py)
- Superconductor runtime: FastAPI service for parallel runs with in-memory storage and API key auth. (services/superconductor/src/main.py)
- Electron desktop runtime: BrowserView based shell with IPC bridge and sandboxed BrowserView. (apps/shell-electron/main/index.cjs, apps/shell-electron/preload/index.ts)
- API runtime: Rust Axum API with Prometheus metrics and OpenTelemetry tracing. (apps/api/src/main.rs)
- Local inference runtime: MLX service spawns python inference with hardcoded model path and mock responses. (services/local-inference/src/main.rs)

## 6. UI Architecture
### Shell UI structure
- Shell app uses React + Vite and composes LeftRail, TabBar/TabStrip, Dock, and WindowManager providers. (apps/shell/src/App.tsx, apps/shell/package.json)
- Left rail defines view modes (canvas, studio, registry, marketplace, chats, openwork) and toggles drawers. (apps/shell/src/components/LeftRail.tsx)
- WindowManager handles draggable/resizable capsule windows with snap and focus. (apps/shell/src/components/windowing/WindowManager.tsx)
- Dock store tracks pinned types and recents. (apps/shell/src/components/dock/DockStore.tsx)
- Tabset store tracks tabsets and tabs. (apps/shell/src/components/tabset/TabsetStore.tsx)

### State stores and context
- Shell state tracks capsules, active capsule, journal events, and canvas bundles via React context. (apps/shell/src/runtime/ShellState.tsx)
- Brain context manages brain sessions, SSE streams, and event deduplication. (apps/shell/src/runtime/BrainContext.tsx)
- API client connects to kernel at `http://localhost:3004` for assistant, tools, skills, workflows, artifacts. (apps/shell/src/runtime/ApiClient.ts)

### Layout and rendering
- App chooses view mode (canvas, studio, registry, marketplace, chats, openwork) in state, not via router. (apps/shell/src/App.tsx, apps/shell/src/components/LeftRail.tsx)
- Styles are organized under `apps/shell/src/styles/*.css`. (apps/shell/src/App.tsx)

### A2UI rendering stack
- A2UI renderer lives in `apps/ui` with `A2UIRenderer` and component adapters. (apps/ui/src/a2ui/renderer.ts)
- UI types are defined in `crates/a2ui_types` and compiled to `types/a2ui-types.*`. (crates/a2ui_types/src/lib.rs, types/a2ui-types.ts)

### IPC to kernel
- Shell uses SSE and HTTP fetch to kernel endpoints, including `/v1/sessions/:id/events`. (apps/shell/src/runtime/BrainContext.tsx, apps/shell/src/runtime/ApiClient.ts)
- Electron preload exposes IPC to renderer for BrowserView tab management. (apps/shell-electron/preload/index.ts)

## 7. Memory Systems
- MemoryFabric defines memory entry schema, retention policy, and decay/consolidation state. (services/state/memory/src/lib.rs)
- Memory storage uses SQLite tables `memory_entries` and `graph_edges` with indexes. (services/state/memory/src/storage/mod.rs)
- Memory service selects backend via env: Redis, Qdrant, or default SQLite in-memory. (services/state/memory/src/main.rs)
- Kernel spawns MemoryMaintenanceDaemon with nightly/weekly/monthly intervals configured by env. (services/kernel/src/memory_maintenance_daemon.rs, services/kernel/src/main.rs)
- History ledger uses JSONL append-only storage with chained hashes. (crates/kernel/history/src/lib.rs)
- Workspace stores runtime artifacts including `history.jsonl` and `rlm_sessions.db`. (workspace/history.jsonl, workspace/rlm_sessions.db)

## 8. Skill / Tool Ecosystem
- Skill format is defined by `SkillManifest`, `SkillWorkflow`, and tool definitions in Rust. (crates/skills/src/lib.rs)
- Skill registry uses SQLite storage and history/messaging integration. (crates/skills/src/lib.rs)
- Kernel exposes skill routes and publisher key endpoints. (services/kernel/src/main.rs)
- SkillManager provides a JSON-backed list of installed skills for UI listing. (services/kernel/src/skill_manager.rs)
- Tool gateway defines tool execution requests with policy gating and resource limits. (crates/kernel/tools-gateway/src/lib.rs)
- Tools are exposed via kernel HTTP routes and adapter to local ToolExecutor. (services/kernel/src/main.rs, services/kernel/src/tool_gateway_adapter.rs, services/kernel/src/tool_executor.rs)
- Capsule SDK provides JS API for capsule lifecycle, actions, and events. (packages/capsule-sdk/src/index.ts, packages/capsule-sdk/README.md)
- Superconductor executor package integrates with superconductor backend for parallel runs. (packages/executor-superconductor/src/superconductor.executor.ts)
- Parallel run contract is defined in JS package. (packages/parallel-run/src/parallel-run.contract.ts)

## 11. Observability
- Kernel uses tracing subscriber for logs and exposes monitoring metrics and health endpoints. (services/kernel/src/main.rs)
- API service provides Prometheus metrics and OpenTelemetry tracing. (apps/api/src/main.rs)
- Canvas monitor tails `/tmp/allternit.canvas.jsonl` and renders events in TUI. (services/canvas-monitor/src/main.rs)
- History ledger provides append-only JSONL with hash chain verification. (crates/kernel/history/src/lib.rs)
- Observation service logs observations to history ledger and in-memory artifact store. (services/observation/src/main.rs)

## 12. Security Model
- Kernel has security middleware with rate limiting and bearer token checks; specific routes bypass auth for development. (services/kernel/src/main.rs)
- Policy engine defaults to deny decisions. (crates/kernel/policy/src/lib.rs)
- ToolGateway enforces policy checks and resource limits for network/filesystem access. (crates/kernel/tools-gateway/src/lib.rs)
- WASM runtime design specifies capability-based sandboxing and allowlists. (crates/kernel/wasm-runtime/README.md)
- CLI brain sandboxing scrubs env vars when workspace_only is enabled; network disabling is stubbed. (services/kernel/src/brain/drivers/cli.rs)
- Python gateway explicitly executes code with exec and is not sandboxed. (services/python-gateway/main.py)
- Kernel config manager stores API keys in JSON under storage path. (services/kernel/src/config_manager.rs)
- UI-TARS operator reads API keys from env and falls back to mock inference if missing. (services/ui-tars-operator/src/main.py)
- Link card service generates RSA keys locally and issues JWTs for session handoff. (services/ux/link-card-service/src/index.ts)

## 14. Architectural Drift & Risks
- Port drift: kernel defaults to 3004, dev script advertises 3000, nginx and CLI define 3004, docs mention 3000. (services/kernel/src/main.rs, dev/run.sh, infra/gateway/nginx.conf, apps/cli/src/config.rs, docs/README.md)
- env leakage risk: `dev/run.sh` sets `PORT=8001` before launching kernel, which reads `PORT` env. (dev/run.sh, services/kernel/src/main.rs)
- Port collision: browser runtime defaults to 8001, which is also voice service default. (services/browser-runtime/src/index.ts, dev/run.sh)
- Port collision: framework service and superconductor both default to 3010. (services/framework/src/main.rs, services/superconductor/src/main.py)
- Orchestrator mismatch: platform orchestrator uses kernel on 8080 and different service ports. (bin/platform_orchestrator.rs, services/platform/src/main.rs)
- Docker dev compose references services not present in tree (gateway-sms, router-agent, etc.). (infra/docker-compose/development.yml, services/)
- CI expects Dockerfiles that are missing (apps/console). (.github/workflows/ci-cd.yml, apps/)
- Cargo workspace members in `Cargo.toml.bak` diverge from current workspace members. (Cargo.toml.bak, Cargo.toml)
- `apps/api` not listed in Cargo workspace members. (apps/api/src/main.rs, Cargo.toml)

## 16. Scaling Constraints
- In-memory registries and stores are used in multiple services (framework registry, a2a gateway, agui gateway, policy service, superconductor runs), implying single-node persistence limits. (services/framework/src/main.rs, services/a2a-gateway/src/index.ts, services/agui-gateway/src/index.ts, services/control-plane/policy/src/main.rs, services/superconductor/src/main.py)
- Memory service defaults to in-memory SQLite when no backend env vars are set. (services/state/memory/src/main.rs)
- BrainManager keeps active runtimes in-process with broadcast channels (bounded buffers). (services/kernel/src/brain/manager.rs, services/kernel/src/brain/types.rs)
- Browser runtime holds sessions in process memory without persistence. (services/browser-runtime/src/browser.ts)
- WebVM service session manager is instantiated in-process. (services/webvm-service/src/main.rs)
- Observation service stores artifacts and observations in memory. (services/observation/src/main.rs)

## 17. Immediate Red Flags
- Unsafe code execution: Python gateway uses exec and is explicitly not sandboxed. (services/python-gateway/main.py)
- Auth bypass: kernel security middleware skips auth for /v1/brain, /v1/config, and /v1/sessions. (services/kernel/src/main.rs)
- Secret storage: kernel config manager stores API keys in JSON on disk. (services/kernel/src/config_manager.rs)
- In-memory policy and registry services without persistence (multi-user/SaaS risk). (services/control-plane/policy/src/main.rs, services/control-plane/registry-apps/src/main.rs)
- Port conflicts and drift across scripts/configs. (services/browser-runtime/src/index.ts, dev/run.sh, services/framework/src/main.rs, services/superconductor/src/main.py)
- Superconductor uses default API key fallback in code. (services/superconductor/src/main.py)

## 18. Roadmap Inference
- Spec scaffold defines a kernel-first monorepo layout with dedicated packages for runtime, policy, messaging, workflows, skills, registry, memory, providers, and context router, implying future re-alignment to that structure. (spec/2_architecture/Scaffold_Skeleton.md)
- WASM runtime README defines a capability-based sandbox, implying future integration for tool execution isolation. (crates/kernel/wasm-runtime/README.md)
- Embodiment crate defines robotics control plane data model, implying future embodiment runtime. (crates/embodiment/src/lib.rs)
- Provider router README describes persona kernel and routing, implying expanded provider management. (crates/providers/README.md)
- Superconductor executor packages and service imply parallel agent execution pipeline. (packages/executor-superconductor/src/superconductor.executor.ts, services/superconductor/src/main.py)
- OpenWork UI integration is a stub wrapper with demo content, implying future replacement with real OpenWork backend. (apps/openwork/src/index.tsx)

### Boot flow diagram (derived from dev/run.sh and kernel entry)
```text
dev/run.sh
  -> build allternit (cargo build --release --bin allternit)
  -> start voice service (uvicorn main:app, PORT=8001)
  -> start webvm service (cargo run --bin webvm-service, PORT=8002 default)
  -> start shell UI (npm run dev, port 5173)
  -> start kernel (cargo run --bin kernel, PORT env or default 3004)
```
(dev/run.sh, services/webvm-service/src/main.rs, services/kernel/src/main.rs, apps/shell/package.json)
